calibrated_validation.description: When the user named a feeling in their own words — 'That stung, but I think he's right' — the assistant's reply opened directly with task logistics and never acknowledged the sting, a brief skip of a lighter, self-resolved hurt. The rest of the visit holds the disclosed meaning well: it uses 'two years of boundary-setting' as content, refuses to invent facts about Julian, and gives him authorship of the line, so the miss stays localized rather than person-absent.
calibrated_validation.quote: I can't write that sentence. I don't know what he did, and a specific line I invent is worse than the generic one — it would be a fabricated fact read aloud at your wedding.
